## VI. When you learned of the sale, and what you did

Q35. When and how did you first learn of the sale to Gloria H. Balane?

A35. In late 2022 or early 2023, when my son Jonathan told me what he had found in the Registry of Deeds records about the sale to Gloria H. Balane. [CONFIRM] [Jonathan learned of the sale in late 2022; her adverse claim of February 2023 says "Lately however, we discovered" the sale; she gives the date and how she learned]

Q36. I show you Exhibit "I", an Affidavit of Adverse Claim. What is it, and whose signature appears on it?

A36. It is the Affidavit of Adverse Claim I executed in February 2023, to have the Registry of Deeds annotate our claim on the title issued to Gloria Balane. The signature over my name is mine. [Exh. I; received by the Registry on March 1, 2023]

Q37. Where were you when you signed it?

A37. In Makati City, Philippines, on February 22, 2023. [CONFIRM] [jurat, Exh. I]

Q38. I show you an Affidavit of Loss you signed in February 2023, for marking as Exhibit "O-1". What is it?

A38. It is the Affidavit of Loss I executed in February 2023 in Makati City. [CONFIRM]

Q39. Why did you execute it?

A39. When Mr. de la Fuente died, the owner's duplicate copies of our titles were not turned over to us or to our new attorney-in-fact. We could not find them. I executed the affidavit so the Registry could annotate it and new owner's duplicate copies could be issued, to protect our titles. [affidavit of loss, ¶¶6–7]

Q40. Paragraph 4 of that affidavit lists "T-52540, now T-079-2021002127." By signing it, did you intend to accept the partition, or the sale to Gloria H. Balane?

A40. No. I listed the titles as the Registry records then showed them. On the same day I signed the Affidavit of Adverse Claim stating that the sale to Gloria Balane was unauthorized and void. [CONFIRM] [Exh. I ¶8]

Q41. Before 2017, did you or your sisters ever hold the owner's duplicate of T-52540?

A41. No. The owner's duplicates stayed with Mr. Llamanzares and then with Mr. de la Fuente. They were never turned over to us. [affidavit of loss, ¶¶3, 6]

Q42. I show you Exhibit "A". What is it?

A42. It is the Special Power of Attorney I signed in favor of my son, Jonathan Zschoche, to represent me in this case. I signed it before a California notary public, and it was apostilled on November 12, 2025. [Exh. A]

Q43. Is there anything you wish to correct or add?

A43. No.
